transcript: I'm officially retiring every other sugar cookie recipe after this. These are my super soft cream cheese sugar cookies, and they are incredible. My husband likes to say that they taste like those loft house grocery store sugar cookies, but 10 times better. Okay, but back to the recipe itself. We're making the dough, of course, with cream cheese and butter. And then it does chill for at least an hour or overnight. And we are making these cookies a quarter inch thick, which gives you the softest and most tender center. Now for our frosting, it's just a little bit of leftover cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla. It dries down so you can easily stack them, and these cookies stay soft for days, although they definitely won't stick around that long.
